visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman sitting in a music studio in front of a large brown grand piano. She is wearing a beige blazer over a white top and a black skirt. In front of her is a white circular plate holding five ripe yellow bananas. She gestures excitedly with both hands raised, palms open, while yellow captions appear at the top and center of the frame. (2) A brief screen recording inset shows a hand using a single banana to play the piano, with TikTok-style UI elements visible. The woman then returns to the main frame, holding a banana and carefully wiping it with a white cleaning cloth while leaning against the piano edge. (3) The woman begins playing the piano. She holds a banana in her right hand, using its curve to press keys an octave apart. She performs several different musical pieces, her facial expressions shifting from focused and romantic to joyful and laughing, then to exaggeratedly sorrowful. Background lighting is bright and even. (4) In a final performance segment, she uses two bananas simultaneously, one in each hand, to play complex chords. The camera remains static in a medium shot, capturing her upper body and the piano keys. The video ends with her playing the piano normally with her fingers, looking relieved and speaking to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the speaker's high-arousal female voice welcoming the audience. She speaks rapidly with bright vocal resonance. No music is present. (2) A transition SFX 'whoosh' leads into a short, lower-fidelity piano clip of 'Fur Elise'. The speaker's voice returns over a soft piano bed as she explains the concept. (3) A sharp 'ding' SFX occurs. As she cleans the banana, soft rustling sounds are heard against a quiet studio background. Her voice maintains a friendly, slightly comedic tone. (4) The first major musical phase begins: 'Marriage d'Amour'. The piano is bright and clear, played at a moderate tempo (~70 BPM). There is no vocal accompaniment. (5) A hard cut shifts the audio to 'Turkish March' at a much faster tempo (~130 BPM). The percussiveness of the piano increases. Short laughter from the speaker is heard in the background. (6) The mood shifts with 'Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence'. The tonality becomes minor and melancholic. Tempo slows down. The piano texture is richer with more sustain. (7) Final musical phase: 'Rhapsody in Blue'. High-energy jazz-influenced piano chords are played. The dynamic range is wide, with loud accents. (8) The video concludes with a quick hand-played piano flourish and the speaker's concluding remarks. She sounds breathless but joyful.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an entertaining musical challenge where a professional pianist tests the claim that a banana's length matches a musical octave. By performing famous classical and contemporary pieces using bananas as tools, she demonstrates both technical skill and a sense of humor, engaging the audience with a viral-style concept.
